sheets.title: PLUMBING FLOOR PLAN – NEW WORK
sheets.reading_notes: Single-level plumbing floor plan at 1/8"=1'-0" scale showing the entirety of the Tidewater Drive Storage Center Phase II building footprint. The building appears to be a large single-story commercial self-storage facility with two distinct wings or zones: (1) a large left/upper portion with long parallel rows of individual storage unit bays (approximately 12-15 rows visible), served by a central corridor, with a service area at upper left containing toilet/sink fixtures (restroom); (2) a lower-right portion with additional storage bays, smaller office area, and a separate service corridor. Plumbing new work shown: SP-1 and SP-2 sump pumps located at elevator pits (two elevators visible on the plan, one in each major section of the building); oil/water separator (labeled OWS-1) shown near the elevator area in lower section; sanitary piping shown routing from sump pits through building to exterior connection. Construction Notes on sheet: (1) provide sump pump in elevator pit per P-001 detail; (2) provide piping route to interior of building, refer to product data/hanger detail for additional info on supporting pipe; (3) provide sump pump flush with grade, refer to oil water separator for requirements of OWS; (4) provide oil water separator flush with grade, refer to product data; (5) provide CAP, pipe underground, route to existing building and route underground to existing main waste piping, and make final connection from oil water separator. Title block: BOWMAN FOSTER & ASSOCIATES, INC., 5042 CHESHIRE AVE, STE. 101, ALEXANDRIA, VA 22312; location: TIDEWATER DR, NORFOLK, VA. BFA DWG file path in CAD title bar: G:\2020\20-009 Tidewater Drive Storage Center - Phase II\NAVIGATOR\P-101 FLOOR PLAN PLUMBING – NEW WORK.dwg (plot date Apr 06 2020). The building plan shows a one-story layout; however, the presence of two elevator pits (and associated sump pumps) strongly implies a multi-story building — elevators typically serve 2+ floors in self-storage. At 1/8"=1'-0" scale, the plan footprint is substantial. Note: no area schedule, no GSF annotation visible on either sheet. Toilet/restroom in service area shows water closet(s) and lavatory but piping for those fixtures not shown as 'new work' on this sheet, suggesting domestic water and sanitary connections for restrooms may be Phase I work.
